regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 2 header, reaction drawing, entries 1–13, and footnotes

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 3 reaction drawing, entries 1–15, and footnotes
regions.finding: Fifteen leaving-group/catalyst/ligand/base conditions were retained. Entry 1 is merged with identical Table 1 entry 7/Table 2 entry 13; entries 12/13 explicitly replace Pd with 5 mol% Cu(OAc)2·H2O or Ni(OAc)2·4H2O, and entry 14 uses 1.5 equiv 2a.

The prose introduces six Scheme 2 arrows shown on page 5: one acetophenone substitution failure, three 2a controls, and two 2d controls. They are represented as six independent experiments with cross-page evidence.
Complexes A/B/C and enolate 2' are proposed Path A/Path B intermediates and are classified in one mechanism record, not as isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 4 center-right Table 4 reaction drawing, entries 1–16, and footnotes
regions.finding: Sixteen independent substrate-scope experiments were retained with 1.0 mmol or row-3 7.5 mmol scale, 1.2 equiv acid, catalyst/ligand/base loadings, THF volumes, 25 or 50 °C, 12 h, isolated yields, and 1.26 g product for the scale-up.

unresolved: The Cu/Ni replacement prose calls them Table 4 entries 12/13 although the displayed rows are in Table 3; the source cross-reference typo is retained in notes.
Control-experiment operational details not printed in Scheme 2 remain missing.

regions.finding: Benzyl deca-1,2-dien-4-yl carbonate 1f plus acetophenone 4a under the displayed standard Pd/binap/LiOBu-t/THF/12 h conditions gives no detectable 3fa.

Three independent 2a controls were retained: THF-only gives 4a 5% NMR/95% recovery; Pd2(dba)3·CHCl3/binap then D2O gives 4a 83% with no D; LiOBu-t then D2O gives 4a-d3 62% at 75% D plus lithium carboxylate 2a' 19%. Ordered 25 °C holds and D2O treatment times are separate steps.

Two independent 2d controls were retained: Pd/binap then D2O gives 4d 94%; LiOBu-t then D2O gives 4d-d3 23% at 71% D plus lithium carboxylate 2d' 64%. Missing quench temperature in equation 3a remains null.
The displayed A/B/C/2' catalytic cycle is the proposed mechanism record, not a sequence of isolated experiments.

Xingguo Jiang is thanked for reproducing Table 4 results 3id, 3ra, and 3si. No independent run details are supplied, so provenance is attached to entries 6, 15, and 16 without creating duplicate records.
Bibliography/prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.
